# OrthoInfo

> > Comprehensive patient education resource from the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) covering orthopedic conditions, injuries, and treatments.

OrthoInfo is the official patient education platform of AAOS, providing evidence-based information on musculoskeletal health, joint conditions, injury prevention, and treatment options. The site serves patients, caregivers, and healthcare consumers seeking reliable orthopedic guidance.

## Key Topics

- AAOS
- American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons
- patient education
- orthopedics
- joint health
- knee arthritis
- osteoarthritis
- rheumatoid arthritis
- cartilage damage
- injury recovery
- treatment options
- medical conditions
- joint pain
- posttraumatic arthritis
- knee anatomy

- [OrthoInfo - Patient Education | AAOS](https://orthoinfo.aaos.org/?topic=A00585): AAOS OrthoInfo homepage for orthopedic patient education and resources
